name: @ryno-crypto/braiins-insights-mcp-server

tools.name: braiins_hashrate_stats
tools.description: Get current Bitcoin network hashrate statistics including current hashrate, estimated hashrate, 30-day average, hash price, transaction fee metrics, and daily network revenue in USD

tools.name: braiins_difficulty_stats
tools.description: Get current Bitcoin network difficulty statistics including current difficulty, estimated next difficulty, difficulty change percentage, blocks until next adjustment, and estimated adjustment time

tools.name: braiins_price_stats
tools.description: Get current Bitcoin price statistics including BTC/USD price, 24-hour price change percentage, and data timestamp

tools.name: braiins_pool_stats
tools.description: Get Bitcoin mining pool distribution statistics including hashrate percentages, blocks mined over different time periods (1d, 1w, 5d, 5w), and pool concentration metrics. Displays pool rankings by effective hashrate and decentralization analysis.

tools.name: braiins_rss_feed_data
tools.description: Get recent Braiins blog posts, announcements, and news from the Braiins Insights RSS feed. Returns titles, publication dates, links, and summaries of the latest content.

tools.name: braiins_halvings
tools.description: Get Bitcoin halving schedule and countdown including next halving date, estimated block height, blocks remaining, current and next block rewards, and historical halving events

tools.name: braiins_transaction_stats
tools.description: Get current Bitcoin network transaction statistics including mempool size, average transaction fees, estimated confirmation time, and 24h transaction volume

tools.name: braiins_blocks
tools.description: Get recent Bitcoin blocks mined with optional pagination and date filtering. Returns block information including height, mining pool, timestamp, transaction count, size, and block hash.

tools.name: braiins_blocks_by_country
tools.description: Get Bitcoin blocks mined by country with geographic distribution. Returns block information including country code, country name, top mining pools, and total blocks mined from each country.

tools.name: braiins_profitability_calculator
tools.description: Calculate Bitcoin mining profitability based on electricity cost and hardware efficiency. Provides daily revenue, electricity costs, net profit, ROI estimates, and break-even analysis. Requires electricity cost (USD/kWh) and hardware efficiency (J/TH) as inputs.

electricity_cost_kwh.description: Electricity cost in USD per kilowatt-hour

hardware_efficiency_jth.description: Hardware efficiency in joules per terahash (e.g., Antminer S19 Pro: ~29.5 J/TH, S21: ~17.5 J/TH)

hardware_cost_usd.description: Optional: Hardware cost in USD for ROI calculation

tools.name: braiins_cost_to_mine
tools.description: Calculate the cost to mine one Bitcoin based on your mining hardware specifications. Requires hashrate (TH/s), power consumption (watts), and electricity cost (USD/kWh). Returns comprehensive profitability analysis including break-even price, daily profit, and cost projections. Use this for mining profitability analysis.

hashrate_ths.description: Mining hardware hashrate in TH/s (e.g., 100 for Antminer S19)

consumption_watts.description: Mining hardware power consumption in watts (e.g., 3000)

electricity_price_per_kwh.description: Electricity cost in USD per kWh (e.g., 0.08)

tools.name: braiins_hardware_stats
tools.description: Get mining hardware specifications and efficiency data. Returns hardware information including model name, hashrate (TH/s), power consumption (W), efficiency (J/TH), manufacturer, and release date.

models.description: Array of hardware model names to fetch stats for (optional)

tools.name: braiins_daily_revenue_history
tools.description: Get historical daily Bitcoin mining revenue data. Returns time-series data showing daily revenue in USD and BTC, useful for analyzing mining profitability trends over time.

limit.description: Maximum number of data points to return (most recent first). Default returns all available data.

tools.name: braiins_hashrate_and_difficulty_history
tools.description: Get historical Bitcoin network hashrate and difficulty data. Returns time-series data showing hashrate (EH/s) and difficulty trends, useful for analyzing network growth patterns.

limit.description: Maximum number of data points to return (most recent first). Default returns all available data.

tools.name: braiins_hashrate_value_history
tools.description: Get historical Bitcoin hashrate value data. Returns time-series data showing the USD value per terahash per day (hash price), useful for analyzing mining economics trends.

limit.description: Maximum number of data points to return (most recent first). Default returns all available data.

tools.name: braiins_transaction_fees_history
tools.description: Get historical Bitcoin transaction fee data. Returns time-series data showing average fees in BTC and sats/vbyte, useful for analyzing fee market trends and miner fee revenue.

limit.description: Maximum number of data points to return (most recent first). Default returns all available data.

tools.name: braiins_mining_overview
tools.description: Get a comprehensive Bitcoin mining ecosystem overview including network hashrate, difficulty status, current BTC price, and recent blocks. Provides a quick 30-second snapshot of mining health and market conditions.

include_recent_blocks.description: Include list of recent blocks in the overview

block_count.description: Number of recent blocks to include

tools.name: braiins_profitability_deep_dive
tools.description: Comprehensive Bitcoin mining profitability analysis combining calculator, cost-to-mine, current market prices, and optional historical hashrate value trends. Provides detailed profitability metrics, break-even analysis, ROI projections, and mining viability recommendations. Requires electricity cost (USD/kWh) and hardware efficiency (J/TH) as inputs.

electricity_cost_kwh.description: Electricity cost in USD per kilowatt-hour

hardware_efficiency_jth.description: Hardware efficiency in joules per terahash (e.g., Antminer S19 Pro: ~29.5 J/TH, S21: ~17.5 J/TH)

include_historical.description: Include historical hashrate value trends for context

historical_days.description: Number of days of historical data to include (7-90)

tools.name: braiins_network_health_monitor
tools.description: Monitor Bitcoin network health with comprehensive indicators including hashrate stability, mempool congestion, and block production timing. Returns a 0-100 health score with alerts for any detected anomalies.
